description: Defines the EntityId interface for identifying entities within the Thingsboard platform, including annotations for JSON serialization/deserialization and Swagger schema, with a focus on entity type discrimination.

classes.name: EntityId
classes.description: Interface for entity identifiers with UUID and entity type, including schema annotations and a method to check for null UUID.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the entity.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the type of the entity.

methods.name: isNullUid
methods.description: Checks if the UUID is the predefined null UUID.
